gizmo.title: Tchati cha radar
gizmo.description: Tchati cha radar (kangaude) cha zitsanzo za kukhwima ndi kupereka zigoli pa mbali, monga HEOSAT. Chili ndi zolemba zina m'malo mwake ndi tebulo la deta.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Mutu wa tchati; umagwiritsidwanso ntchito ngati dzina lake lofikirika.

configure.title: Magulu
configure.description: Gulu limodzi pa mzere uliwonse. Pakufunika osachepera 3.

configure.title: Zigoli
configure.description: Manambala olekanitsidwa ndi koma, imodzi pa gulu lililonse motsatira momwemo.

configure.title: Zigoli zolinga
configure.description: Manambala olekanitsidwa ndi koma, imodzi pa gulu lililonse motsatira momwemo.

configure.title: Onetsani tanthauzo la zizindikiro
configure.description: Onetsani tanthauzo la zizindikiro lotchula zigoli ndi zolinga.

configure.title: Chaching'ono
configure.description: Tchati chaching'ono chopanda zilembo, tanthauzo la zizindikiro kapena tebulo la deta. Ikani cholozera pa poyimilira kuti muwone mitengo yake.

advanced.title: Chilembo cha zigoli
advanced.description: Chilembo cha zigoli pa tanthauzo la zizindikiro ndi tebulo.

advanced.title: Chilembo cha zolinga
advanced.description: Chilembo cha zolinga pa tanthauzo la zizindikiro ndi tebulo.
